tools.name: get_site_capabilities
tools.description: Describe Chapa and list its agent-facing tools and entry points.

tools.name: find_profile
tools.description: Resolve a GitHub handle to its Chapa profile and badge URLs.

tools.name: get_impact_profile
tools.description: Return the selected policy receipt, including v7.4 or v7.5 recorded activity and product outcomes for a GitHub handle, including its policy, identity, exact/display points and Quality breakdown. When no receipt is drawable, return scoringStatus and the initial Emerging archetype for registered users

tools.name: get_impact_history
tools.description: Return policy-labelled daily receipt winners and trends for a GitHub handle, including the desired policy and upgrade state.

tools.name: verify_badge
tools.description: Look up the public verification result for a Chapa badge hash.

tools.name: explain_verification
tools.description: Explain Chapa badge verification guarantees and limits.

tools.name: explain_dimension
tools.description: Explain one impact dimension from the selected policy receipt, including sealed v7.4 or v7.5 contributions and outcome availability, automatic Quality and optional reviewed bonus.

tools.name: compare_profiles
tools.description: Compare two public Chapa impact profiles by the headline each badge draws.

tools.name: get_embed_snippet
tools.description: Return ready-to-paste Markdown and HTML for a live Chapa badge.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_impact_profile" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the latest public impact profile for a GitHub handle." → after: "Return the selected policy receipt, including v7.4 or v7.5 recorded activity and product outcomes for a GitHub handle, including its policy, identity, exact/display points and Quality breakdown. When no receipt is drawable, return scoringStatus and the initial Emerging archetype for registered users"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
